Hi Sofia / Jeroen —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Key requirements we heard: EU data residency for production inference, a pilot in APAC (Singapore) later this year, and clear rules around cross-region routing and data-at-rest encryption.
- Current prioritization: EU residency is blocking for initial roll out; APAC pilot is P2.
- Main question for us: whether Hosted API in an EU region meets your residency and procurement requirements, or if you will need Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) for the EU workload.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sofia/Jeroen: confirm whether the procurement/security team will accept a Hosted API that stores data in an EU region (we can provide SOC2 and data residency docs), or whether they require customer-managed VPC/on-prem.
2) We’ll schedule a short technical call (30 min) with Aditya to walk through routing, encryption, and isolation options.  Please share times that work.
3) I’ll attach the data-residency template you can fill with specifics (data types, retention, access rules).

I’ve CC’d Procurements for visibility. I’ll loop in Aditya and Neha for the technical / deployment timeline options once you confirm whether Hosted API is acceptable.

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side after speaking with procurement/security:

- For production, FinBank requires that customer data at-rest and logs remain in the EU. In an ideal state, the inference endpoints and storage would be hosted in an EU region (Frankfurt or Dublin).
- For the APAC pilot we expect non-sensitive test traffic only; however, we do want a Singapore-hosted option later this year.
- Cross-region routing: procurement will want guarantees that EU production traffic does not transit to non-EU regions. They are open to Hosted API if you can guarantee region-local processing and provide SOC2 + data residency evidence.
- If you cannot provide region-local guarantees or if routing still involves cross-region fallbacks that store logs outside EU, procurement will likely require a Private VPC or on-prem deployment.

I attached a filled data-residency worksheet with our high-level answers (see attachment). Could we schedule the technical call next week? Tue 20th or Wed 21st mornings CET work for us.

Best regards,
Sofia Müller
Head of AI Integrations | FinBank
sofia.muller@finbank.eu

Thanks Sofia — that is super helpful. 

Quick response so you have the options ahead of the technical call: 

Option A — Hosted API (recommended for fastest time-to-value)
- EU regions (Frankfurt and Dublin) are available for Hosted customers; production inference and logs can be scoped to EU regions.
- We can provide SOC2 attestation and a data-residency statement.
- Tradeoffs: Shared control plane, but data plane can be region-local. If you need isolated compute, Dedicated (reserved capacity) is an option.

Option B — Dedicated (reserved capacity in EU)
- Dedicated GPU pools in an EU region with predictable throughput and stronger isolation than Hosted.
- Good middle-ground when you need capacity guarantees but not full Private networking.

Option C — Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem)
- Private control plane + customer-managed VPC or on-prem package for maximum isolation and compliance.
- Longer lead time (technical setup, network integration, KMS/HSM configuration).

For the call, Aditya will walk through cross-region routing behavior and how fallbacks work (we support strict region pinning + can disable automatic cross-region fallback for compliance-sensitive tenants). Neha will cover estimated timelines and procurement artifacts (SOC2, data processing addenda).

Proposed times: Tue Jul 20, 09:00-09:30 CET or Wed Jul 21, 09:00-09:30 CET. Which works?

Link to proposed mutual action plan and details: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Thanks — attaching SOC2 and a short residency FAQ for your team to review ahead of the call.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Deployment residency & region availability - FinBank follow-up

Internal notes for the call and for Marissa to share with procurement/security: 

- EU region coverage: Public Hosted API is currently available in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) and eu-west-1 (Dublin). Both regions support region-local processing for inference requests and region-local blob storage for logs and artifacts.
- Cross-region routing: By default we have smart routing and fallbacks to nearest compatible region for availability, but we support strict region pinning per-tenant. If FinBank requires no cross-region fallback, we can disable fallbacks and ensure all processing is constrained to EU.
- Data at-rest + logs: We support customer-scoped log retention and can restrict storage to EU buckets. We also offer integration with customer KMS/HSM for key control in Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Private deployments: VPC/on-prem lead time estimate is ~8-10 weeks for integration (includes network peer, KMS, and audit). Dedicated capacity spin-up is typically 4-6 weeks depending on resource availability. Hosted API in an EU region is immediate for a proof-of-concept/P0.
- Artifacts: SOC2 attestation and the residency FAQ are attached for procurement.

Action items:
- Marissa: Confirm call time with FinBank and share the residency FAQ + SOC2.
- Neha: Prepare a short timeline slide (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) we can send to procurement during the call.

Thanks,
Aditya
